text: This page answers the Southeast follow-up the Sales Director already asked for back in the very first meeting, going from the headline number to which part of the business is actually driving it.
A horizontal bar chart ranks churn rate by region, sorted descending, with Southeast highlighted directly so it's unmistakable without reading a single axis label.

A matrix crosses Region against Segment, with both Churned Customers and Churn Rate as values, letting the reader cross-tabulate two dimensions at once instead of needing a separate chart for every combination.

Three slicers, Region, Segment, Loyalty Tier, stay page-level rather than synced to the executive page, since forcing a Southeast filter onto that all-regions baseline would defeat its purpose. A bookmark pre-filters to Southeast specifically, surfaced as a one-click button on the executive page. And before calling it done, the matrix's churned total has to match the executive page's card exactly, a mismatch here is a modeling problem, not a rounding difference.
The drill-down is built and reconciled. Next: rebuilding this same view in Tableau, for the team that already lives there.
